analysis.explanation: The document lacks a main landmark region, which is typically represented by the <main> element. Screen reader users rely on landmarks to quickly navigate to the primary content of the page.
analysis.recommended_fix: Wrap the primary content of the page in a <main> element, or add role="main" to the primary content container.
analysis.corrected_code: <main id="main-content"><!-- Primary page content goes here --></main>
verification_steps: Verify that a <main> element or role="main" is present in the DOM.
Run an automated accessibility test to ensure the landmark-one-main rule passes.
Test with a screen reader to verify that the main landmark is correctly identified and navigable.
